programme.title: Simon Daniel
programme.desc: An archaeologist embarks on a treasure hunt in an old estate, which his now missing friend had started. His mission to find his friend and the treasure does not come without the horrors of the place.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery and bloodshed.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: 7th Day
programme.desc: When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess but he is not what he claims to be.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

The trio learn how the Brontës combined literary genius with real life experience to create some of the best-loved novels in the English language.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: Elio, a misfit kid, is mistaken for Earth's ambassador in space and bonds with aliens while discovering his true self. Pixar animation, with the voice of Yonas Kibreab.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
programme.desc: Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot.

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: A crop duster longs to be a racing plane, but is hamstrung by a fear of heights. With the aid of a veteran flyer, he learns to conquer his phobia and compete against some of the world's greatest flyers in a round-the-world race. Animated adventure spin-off from Pixar's Cars, with the voices of Dane Cook, Teri Hatcher and Stacy Keach.

programme.title: Captain America: Civil War
programme.desc: The superhuman soldier is propelled into conflict with his Avengers teammate Iron Man over a system of government control over their actions - a situation made worse when an old friend is accused of being behind a terror attack. As a cunning conspiracy surrounds them all, Captain America finds himself battling former allies, vengeful enemies, and new heroes on the block Black Panther and Spider-Man. Superhero adventure, starring Chris Evans, Robert Downey Jr and Scarlett Johansson.

programme.title: The Heat
programme.desc: An uptight, ambitious FBI agent is sent to Boston to bring a notorious drug kingpin to justice. She ends up forced to team up with a rebellious, foul-mouthed local police detective who has a very different attitude to law enforcement but shares her inability to work with others. Action comedy, starring Sandra Bullock and Melissa McCarthy.

programme.title: Hitman: Agent 47
programme.desc: The latest in a long line of genetically engineered clones bred to be the perfect assassin takes on a mission that strikes close to home. A corporation intends to use the technology that created him to build an army of superhuman killers. As the assassin fights to bring them down, he uncovers the dark secrets surrounding his origin. Action thriller, starring Rupert Friend, Hannah Ware and Zachary Quinto.

programme.title: Let's Be Cops
programme.desc: Two friends go to a fancy-dress party as police officers, and are amazed by how people on the street react to their uniforms. They decide to pose as cops in the hope of enjoying the perks of the job, but soon end up in over their heads with gangsters and corrupt members of the real force. Comedy, starring Jake Johnson and Damon Wayans Jr.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Planes

With the aid of a veteran flyer, he learns to conquer his phobia and compete against some of the world's greatest flyers in a round-the-world race. Animated adventure spin-off from Pixar's Cars, with the voices of Dane Cook, Teri Hatcher and Stacy Keach.

programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

His mission leads him on another globe-trotting treasure hunt that uncovers a secret conspiracy. Adventure sequel, starring Nicolas Cage, Helen Mirren, Ed Harris, Harvey Keitel and Jon Voight.

Fantasy adventure based on the Marvel comic, starring Benedict Cumberbatch, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Mads Mikkelsen, Tilda Swinton and Rachel McAdams.

However, his plans for a normal school life for the youngster are foiled when the youngster's mathematical abilities come to the attention of Frank's formidable mother, Evelyn. Drama, starring Chris Evans, Lindsay Duncan and Mckenna Grace.

Sci-fi adventure from director Paul Verhoeven, starring Casper Van Dien, Denise Richards and Dina Meyer.

programme.desc: A child who grows up in slavery becomes a formidable warrior and a cunning thief. Fantasy adventure, based on the stories by author Robert E Howard, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Max von Sydow, James Earl Jones and Sandahl Bergman.

programme.desc: A teenager is shocked to discover he is the son of Greek god Poseidon and has been accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt. Fantasy adventure, starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan, Brandon T Jackson, Alexandra Daddario, Jake Abel, Sean Bean and Steve Coogan.

Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
programme.desc: S1 E3Josie Gibson and the team are in Brighton helping Dan, whose home has been taken over by his fiancee's stash of vintage treasures. Natacha used to run an online vintage shop, but since the arrival of their baby everything has been put on hold. As a result, one room is now full of old stock and new dad Dan wants it gone to create a bedroom for their daughter. Tensions run high when all is revealed - is the offer big enough to entice Natacha to take the cash.

programme.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
programme.desc: S1 E4Josie Gibson, Dan Hatfield and Jacqueline McLeod help Tim, who wants to sell items his girlfriend Sally has spent a lifetime collecting. While Sally is shopping in London, Josie and the team rummage through her many unique items. Arriving home to discover her treasures have been boxed up and valued, will Sally keep her collections or take the cash.

programme.title: Barry Humphries: The Last Laugh
programme.desc: A profile of the comedy writer and performer, taking an upbeat and honest look back at the life and work of the trailblazer behind Dame Edna Everage and Sir Les Patterson. Barry's friends including Nick Cave, Jason Donovan, Jonathan Ross, Sharon Osbourne and Alison Hammond pay tribute to a man who proved as complex as he was funny.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — EdinburghJames and his companion Tom Kitchin head to Edinburgh, but first they take a detour to a whisky distillery in Pitlochry, where James knocks up whisky chicken with wild mushroom and mustard sauce. Once they reach the capital, Tom shares his knowledge of the local fish, James gets fitted for a kilt and learns the history of the iconic garment, and the pair enjoy a bite to eat at Tom's Michelin-starred restaurant.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.desc: S1 E3Josie Gibson and the team are in Brighton helping Dan, whose home has been taken over by his fiancee's stash of vintage treasures. Natacha used to run an online vintage shop, but since the arrival of their baby everything has been put on hold. As a result, one room is now full of old stock and new dad Dan wants it gone to create a bedroom for their daughter. Tensions run high when all is revealed - is the offer big enough to entice Natacha to take the cash.

programme.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
programme.desc: S1 E4Josie Gibson, Dan Hatfield and Jacqueline McLeod help Tim, who wants to sell items his girlfriend Sally has spent a lifetime collecting. While Sally is shopping in London, Josie and the team rummage through her many unique items. Arriving home to discover her treasures have been boxed up and valued, will Sally keep her collections or take the cash.

programme.title: Barry Humphries: The Last Laugh
programme.desc: A profile of the comedy writer and performer, taking an upbeat and honest look back at the life and work of the trailblazer behind Dame Edna Everage and Sir Les Patterson. Barry's friends including Nick Cave, Jason Donovan, Jonathan Ross, Sharon Osbourne and Alison Hammond pay tribute to a man who proved as complex as he was funny.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — EdinburghJames and his companion Tom Kitchin head to Edinburgh, but first they take a detour to a whisky distillery in Pitlochry, where James knocks up whisky chicken with wild mushroom and mustard sauce. Once they reach the capital, Tom shares his knowledge of the local fish, James gets fitted for a kilt and learns the history of the iconic garment, and the pair enjoy a bite to eat at Tom's Michelin-starred restaurant.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.title: UK Crime Files: Anagram Serial Killer
programme.desc: Jackie Malton revisits the case of Scottish serial killer Peter Tobin, meeting the Glasgow officers and forensic scientists who put him behind bars for the first time on camera.

programme.title: UK Crime Files: Murder-Folie A Deux
programme.desc: The story of what happened when the remains of a woman's body were found in the back of a blazing car. The suspected killers were both convicted murderers out of prison on parole.

programme.title: UK Crime Files: The Brutal Bludgeon
programme.desc: The story of Jehovah's Witness Sharon Gordon, who was killed by her builder in Dudley, after tensions over her home extension. Doorbell footage captures crucial evidence.

programme.title: UK Crime Files: Murder: Broken Trust
programme.desc: The story of an elderly woman who died in a house fire in Nottinghamshire. Attention turned to the daughter-in-law who controlled her keys, bills and access to family money.

programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre meets former DCI Clive Driscoll to discover how he solved the murder of Coventry-born Surjit Athwal, which proved to be a landmark case.

programme.title: Britain's Countryside Killers

programme.title: Deadly Destinations
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Mutinous MurderThe case of retirees Tom and Jackie Hawkes, who sold their yacht for cash before disappearing. Detectives investigate the charming young couple who bought it.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives
programme.desc: S4 E3 — Norcal RapistThe first in a long series of violent assaults occur, claiming victims in five different counties of North California, including Sonoma, Solano, Contra Costa, Yolo and Butte.

programme.desc: E1Ranged weapons guarantee a warrior's best chance of survival. International experts survey history’s most important ranged weapons, from the Roman spear and the English longbow, right up to the futuristic railgun.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E2Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: History Of Weapons

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E4From the crossbow to the Kalashnikov to 3D-printed firearms, weaponry designed for everyone can offer a decisive advantage in warfare.

programme.title: History Of Weapons

programme.title: History Of Weapons

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E7A look at key maritime weapons such as the secret super-weapon that kept Constantinople safe for centuries, the thunderous force of a ship's cannon, and the deadly torpedo.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E8Examining how the techniques of ambush, along with weapons that remained undetected until the very moment they were used, would revolutionise warfare.

programme.title: History Of Weapons

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
